# Package: `padt` {#sec-package-padt}

::: {.callout-tip title="Online Package Documentation"}
The `padt` package provides data science tooling for the *Pythia’s Advice* project, including:

- Data extraction from SAP/CSV to Parquet
- Pre-built data.table summaries
- DuckDB and Arrow integration

Explore the full documentation and examples online:

[Open **PADT** documentation site](https://Fpadt.github.io/EAISI-Padt){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
